name: agy-companion
description: Bring your own models (BYOM) and track token usage in Google Antigravity (agy) via a local Rust Gemini proxy sidecar and native Aux Pane Web UI.
suggestedPrompts: Open the Antigravity Companion settings panel
Generate customModelsConfig JSON for my local Antigravity Companion proxy
Run agy-companion doctor and troubleshoot my local proxy setup
